# NFL Daily — 2026-10-27 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Colts traded DT DeForest Buckner back to the 49ers, getting a 2027 fourth-round pick in return — their second major trade-deadline move of the day. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2115182685547368706) — also [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2115182581683548390)
- Colts traded eight-time Pro Bowl G Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks for a 2027 third-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2115120099505905765) — also [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2115120166782865806)
- Giants placed RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve with a hamstring injury; Devin Singletary is expected to see a bigger role. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50300226/giants-place-rb-tyrone-tracy-ir-hamstring-injury)
- Jay-Z will headline the Super Bowl LXI halftime show. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50293241/jay-z-headline-super-bowl-lxi-half-show)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is believed to be close to 100% and is expected to play Sunday at Buffalo, per Ian Rapoport. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Cardinals RB James Conner was placed on injured reserve (foot); coach Mike LaFleur said he could "potentially" return this season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
